build_glyph_embedding: build a GlyphEmbedding module with a given glyph_type strategy and embedding dimension
prepare_input_glyph_tuple: prepare input dictionary into a GlyphTuple namedtuple for embedding lookup
forward_embed_glyphs: run the forward pass to embed a GlyphTuple and return concatenated embedding vectors
glyphs_to_idgroup: convert glyph tensors into subgroup ids and group ids using the id_pairs_table
configure_targets_strategy: configure a Targets NamedTuple to select which glyph features to embed and in what ratios
